2014_spells.resistance.description: You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one saving throw of its choice. It can roll the die before or after making the saving throw. The spell then ends.
2014_spells.resistance.effectSummary: It can roll the die before or after making the saving throw
2014_spells.resistance.fullDescription: Using 1 action, you touch one willing creature. It can roll the die before or after making the saving throw; Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one saving throw of its choice. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one saving throw of its choice; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
